note: Bot numbers from scripts/balance/sim.ts, not human ones: they say whether the keep moved, not how hard it is. Bands are deliberately loose so they catch accidental large drift, not tuning. A deliberate balance change is expected to fail npm run balance:check and to update this file (measured and bands) in the same pull request. Rates and HP are percentages (death rate is of runs that reached the floor; HP left is the median over floors cleared); run length is seconds. With 30 runs one run is 3.3 points of a rate. Plan 016 (2026-09-28): floors became chains of sealed chambers joined by doors, with no corridors or dead ends to walk; the median run fell from 268.5s to 141.3s (default) and from 236s to 122.5s (weak). Only the run-length bands moved; every other metric stayed inside its old band.
